messages:
asha: Quick: adding a tiny starter that pairs Redwood + LangChain for demoing eval harnesses. Link internal: https://git.redwood.local/next-llama-eval-starter
connor: Love it. Ran through the quickstart and got stuck on auth flows. The API proxy is swallowing Authorization header.
mina: Which proxy? /api/redwood? snippet: ```export default async function handler(req,res){ const headers = {'content-type':'application/json'}; const r = await fetch(process.env.REDWOOD_HOST + req.url, {method:req.method, headers, body: JSON.stringify(req.body)}); res.status(r.status).send(await r.text()); }```
asha: yep. In dev mode we expect the cookie to be forwarded. Also the browser SDK doesn't retry 429s. That makes the eval harness flaky under CI.
connor: we should update proxy to forward incoming headers (authorization, cookie) and add server-side fallback to append Authorization from REDWOOD_API_KEY if present.
mina: Also add fetchWithRetry wrapper in src/lib that mirrors node behavior. Small sample implementation we can include in the starter README.
build-bot: build/test queued for branch asha/fix-proxy-retries (build #9)
asha: plan: 1) patch proxy header forwarding; 2) add client retry helper; 3) add scripts/eval-harness.js with MOCK_TELEMETRY_URL support; 4) set default cache TTL in sample to 300 seconds. I'll open PR and assign.
